confidence_notes: Recent Ayutthaya-level listings give usable meal, cappuccino, and beer anchors, though mid-range meal estimates vary. Cocktail and wine prices vary sharply by venue. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge; no accommodation listings were checked.
comparable_city_reasoning: Treat Ayutthaya as a provincial central-Thai heritage destination with day-trip tourism, using regional Thai pricing with a modest allowance for visitor-facing restaurants and bars rather than Bangkok-wide pricing.
